cassini.scope: Collection metadata, historical recording provenance and individual detached XML label where accessible. No receiver waveform or engineering data accessed. No operational use.

natural.selection: Exact published epoch candidates first, then earliest and latest distinct dates of exact aliases, fine-format candidates only. Do not discard HTTP catalog URLs; use HTTPS equivalent only after validating official hostname; never infer observation from name alone. For other maser fields report observation grid only, not line presence.
natural.scope: Natural sky source header audit, no intensity read or emission verification.

gates: Catalogue or detached label is not a verified signal. Verify actual source time, native grid, continuity, line detection and independent session later.
No physical emitter identification model; G4/Hybrid R28 unchanged; no veto or new labels.
